acceptedAnswer.text: “Smart Buildings: AI-Powered Efficiency and Sustainability” is a practical, plain-English guide to how AI is reshaping building operations, sustainability, maintenance, and occupant comfort.
It’s written for property leaders, facilities teams, sustainability professionals, and curious readers who want useful insight without wading through academic theory.
No. It focuses on clear concepts, practical examples, and decision-making rather than heavy maths or code.

mainEntity.name: What will I get from it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll come away with a clearer grasp of the main AI use-cases, operational trade-offs, and how to think about smart-building adoption sensibly.
You can buy the ebook via the Amazon link on this page.
